spanish: Yovel ella, año de los cincuenta año, será a ustedes; no sembrarán, y no segarán su espontáneo, y no vendimiarán sus nazires.

findings.issue: Common noun (HNcmsa, H3104) is left as the untranslated form Yovel.
Masculine plural noun plus 3fs suffix is rendered as singular su espontáneo, changing number.
Common noun (HNcmpc, H5139) is dumped as the untranslated form nazires.

notes: 2mp futures match ustedes; both שנה remain singular.
